cues: On the right, part of the heat was spent pushing the piston and the atmosphere back, so less was left to raise the temperature.
To get the same temperature rise at constant pressure, you must supply more heat.
So C p is always bigger than C v.
text: The clamped gas gets hotter. On the right, part of the heat was spent pushing the piston and the atmosphere back, so less was left to raise the temperature. To get the same temperature rise at constant pressure, you must supply more heat. So C p is always bigger than C v.
